items.en_title: Alegrete (RS) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 30 #1
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Alegrete (RS) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 49,000; proposals close Nov 30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
